# `gcp.certificatemap`

CertificateMap defines a collection of certificate configurations, which are usable by any associated target proxies

[certificatemanager](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| Service | certificatemanager |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `certificatemanager.googleapis.com/CertificateMap` |

| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
